title: OpenAI merges Chat and Work with single usage meter
excerpt: OpenAI combines ChatGPT Chat and Work experiences, warning heavy users they may reach usage limits sooner.
body_html:
OpenAI is combining its Chat and Work experiences into a unified platform. As part of this update, the company will introduce a single usage meter across ChatGPT.

Due to this consolidation, heavy users of the platform may reach their usage limits sooner than before.
